title: No reminders anymore
body: Google wants me to install another app (Google Calendar) just to set reminders for notes. That’s frustrating and unnecessarily complicated.
author: chandanak

title: AMAZING App for customizable to do lists
body: I absolutely LOVE Google Keep!!! I am obsessed with the fact that you can create customized headers for each note. I insert an image which I use as a heading (eg. Groceries) and then use the checkboxes. I use it daily and have organized my daily and monthly tasks on it. I appreciate that it’s so easy to use, syncs on phone and web, and personalized to your liking. I can’t say enough about how useful and helpful it’s been to make life easier :)
